summary: 023 correctly moves archive numbering to a project-wide monotonic sequence and keeps Change 2 at 021, but it assigns identity too early by treating Delivery planning slots as a permanent ordinal ledger. A Change should receive/freeze its project ordinal only when it actually enters Explore; explored-then-cancelled retains the number, planned-only consumes none, and Archive later reuses the already-assigned number. D03 Change 3 is still planned with no Explore and therefore does not yet own 022.
complexityAssessment: REDUCE planning-slot identity semantics; no new control plane.
